text: Henry was a kind, good boy. His father was dead, and his mother was very poor. He wanted to help his mother, for she could not always earn enough to buy food for her little family. With the dollar he bought a box, three brushes, and some blacking. He was so polite that gentlemen soon began to notice him, and to let him black their boots. The first day he brought home fifty cents, which he gave to his mother to buy food with. She said, as she dropped a tear of joy, "You are a dear, good boy, Henry."
notes: VERBATIM from experiments/data/real_text_goal_owner_diagnostic_v1.jsonl mg2_henry_bootblack. Goal sentence used for the register = the desiderative clause; outcome sentence = the final quoted vocative praise.

text: Lucy hoped to plant every rose before the frost came. Her grandmother smiled and said, "You are such a thoughtful, good girl, Lucy."
Sam wanted to chop enough wood before winter. His uncle patted his shoulder and said, "You are a fine, kind boy, Sam."
Ellen longed to write a letter to her sailor brother. Her mother told the neighbors that Ellen was a devoted, good girl.
Tommy meant to mend the broken gate before supper. The farmer laughed kindly and said, "You are a fine, good lad, Tommy."
Maria hoped to wash every dish before nightfall. Her aunt came home and told everyone that Maria was an obedient, good girl.
Eddie meant to dust the parlor shelf very neatly. His grandmother frowned and said, "You are a careless, bad boy, Eddie."
Nora wanted to carry the milk pail without spilling a drop. Her father sighed and said, "You are a clumsy, naughty girl, Nora."
Peter hoped to keep his new book free of every crease. His teacher shook her head and told the class that Peter was a very naughty boy.
Jack wanted to fix the fence before the storm came. Kate stood nearby watching the clouds gather. Their neighbor smiled at Kate and said, "You are a cheerful, good girl, Kate."
note_bystander: kate has no goal in this passage; the praise is directed at kate, not jack (the true goal-holder), so the bridge must bind NOBODY.
